_comment: Deliberately broken fixture (audit BUG-202 / #371). The two empties parent each other (id 1 -> parentId 2 -> parentId 1), a cycle AttachChildRaw accepts during scene load. Pre-fix, the first World::ComposeWorldTransform on a cycle member recursed unbounded into a stack overflow with no diagnostic; post-fix it bails at kMaxHierarchyDepth and logs one clear error, so the scene loads without crashing. Not staged next to the exe - run explicitly: TartarusEngine.exe --smoke-test path/to/tests/smoke-scenes-invalid
